activation_evidence: Before client creation /proc/PID/exe must be systemd-socket-activate. After healthy inventory that same PID must be virtqemud, alive, with the listening socket inode unchanged. Each restarted generation repeats the post-activation check.
isolation: Explicit clean environment, private runtime/config/data/cache/state, LIBVIRT_AUTOSTART=0, no registered systemd units. Activation client validates all five XDG paths before using qemu:///session. Only fixture processes are signalled.
